instruction: The cramped control room of a mid-century submarine: a periscope column with fold-down handles, walls of valve wheels, pipes and riveted panels, a glowing green sonar scope, a chart table with instruments, crew bunks in an alcove, and a red alert lamp slowly rotating. Gauges tremble and the sonar sweep pings in the dim interior.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Submarine Control Room. The cramped control room of a mid-century submarine: a periscope column with fold-down handles, walls of valve wheels, pipes and riveted panels, a glowing green sonar scope, a chart table with instruments, crew bunks in an alcove, and a red alert lamp slowly rotating. Gauges tremble and the sonar sweep pings in the dim interior. Style: industrial retro-tech. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
